observations.text: The homepage positions the site as a personal/project hub rather than a service-business funnel.

claims.text: Modernization should prioritize project routing and identity continuity over quote/contact CTAs.

recommendedNextSteps.title: Confirm the primary visitor path
recommendedNextSteps.rationale: The next design pass should route visitors to live projects, planned channels, or build notes based on the site owner's intent.

openQuestions: Which project or channel should receive the strongest homepage emphasis?
